name: release-14-ops-list-blueprints
description: A ggui_ops_list_blueprints result as ggui tag 14 (b68b964a7, serving prod and staging) emitted it for one generation-minted row, captured from staging serving that tag (`ggui-protocol-b68b964a7737`, 2026-09-27T16:40Z) on a fixture app after one cold render. Every byte is verbatim except `codeS3Url`: its bucket names the hosted deployment's store, so the value keeps the served shape (`s3://<bucket>/code/<codeHash>.js`) over a neutral bucket. The row carries NO `build`: tag 14 declares the stamp and no writer emits it. Today's opsListBlueprintsOutputSchema MUST accept the result, and the parsed row MUST still carry no `build` — an unstamped row reads as an unknown minting build, never an error, and a reader never invents one (ggui#1280, VERSION-POLICY §3.6).
